proposal.summary: A cross-site request forgery (CSRF) vulnerability in Jenkins Frugal Testing Plugin 1.1 and earlier allows attackers to connect to Frugal Testing using attacker-specified credentials and to retrieve test IDs and names if a valid credential corresponds to the attacker-specified username.
proposal.affected_product: Jenkins Frugal Testing Plugin 1.1 and earlier

C.quote: retrieve test IDs and names from Frugal Testing

proposal.recommended_next_step: Attempt to reproduce the issue by crafting a CSRF request against the plugin endpoints to verify that an attacker-supplied request can connect using attacker-specified credentials and retrieve test IDs/names; identify affected endpoints and add/verify CSRF token enforcement or release a plugin update.
